_README: Owned by this repository (seeded by the AI-Handbook sync, completed 2026-10-15 for #683 Phase 1). Contract: docs/ai-context/agent-legible-codebase.md. Approved plan: docs/plans/PLAN_AGENT_LEGIBLE_CODEBASE.md, decisions 1 and 2. Setting enabled to false stands every guard and the forcing rule down at once (the back-out).
_sets: Indexed: every source file under the six areas below; artifacts/mockup-sandbox is a design space with no production consumer and is left out. Headered: indexed minus tests and e2e (their purpose is the describe block), vendored components/ui, the type templates patch-generated.mjs copies verbatim into generated output, codegen-owned paths, .d.ts and synced files (the last three by the tool itself). Sized: the headered set.
_codegenOwned: Every generated source-output family, with the command that owns it. lib/api-zod/src/index.ts is rewritten by the api-spec codegen (measured 2026-10-15 by planting a comment and running codegen); lib/api-client-react/src/index.ts is not, and is handwritten.
